payload.entry: Separated success-path finalizer failures from provider-failure recovery in invoke_agent; preserved the finalizer error and normal error postprocessing without recording provider failure or retrying. Seeded controller attempt IDs above existing per-instance artifacts and progress events while retaining the per-phase attempt budget. Added regressions for staged handoff hold/provider-success behavior and persisted attempt numbering. Verified: focused tests passed; sase tool run check passed (scoped tests 10m 47s); the macro and prepared host completion callers do not retry after exceptions. Epic symbols reported no remaining entries.
